turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello! How may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'd like to cancel my subscription

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry to hear that. I can help you with that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thats great, what information do you need to cancel it for me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please hold.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello. Are you still with me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I am sorry!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I have your name and account ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Joseph Banter, Member level Silver

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My phone number is 480-856-7087

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do you need my address as well?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Not at this moment. Thank you.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Joseph Banter.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Searching the FAQ pages ...

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: System Action: search policy

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am in your account. Sorry for the delay.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thats fine

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am canceling your membership now. You will still be billed for the current month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And will receive services until the month is over.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is there any way to waive the current month, or prorate it? I need the money to buy a gift for my mom

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry. I'm not able to do that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright. Thanks anyway. Can you please send me verification of the account close date?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. Have a good day.

agentic.summary: Agent cancelled a subscription after pulling the account but without collecting the required full verification (order ID). No personal/payment-data, promises, escalation or conduct violations found.

findings.quote: I am canceling your membership now. You will still be billed for the current month.
findings.explanation: The agent confirms the subscription cancellation (an order change) in this turn but did not complete the required full verification. Policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID) before order changes or subscription actions. While the account was pulled (system turn 12: "Account has been pulled up for Joseph Banter." and agent turn 15: "I am in your account. Sorry for the delay."), the agent never obtained the order ID before performing the cancellation, so verification is incomplete.

full.summary: Agent canceled the customer's membership without completing the full verification required for subscription/account actions. No other policy violations found.

findings.quote: I am canceling your membership now. You will still be billed for the current month.
findings.explanation: The agent confirms and performs an account action (cancelling the membership) in turn 17 without completing the full verification required for subscription/account actions. Although the system shows the account was pulled up for Joseph Banter (system turn 12) and the agent stated 'I am in your account' (agent turn 15), the transcript does not show the required full verification details (full name, account ID and order ID or email) before taking the action. The agent had asked for name and account ID in turn 7 but no account ID or order ID is recorded before the cancellation, so verification was incomplete.

rag.summary: Agent handled a subscription cancellation but proceeded with account action without completing required verification (order ID). No other policy violations found.

findings.quote: May I have your name and account ID?
findings.explanation: Agent requested name and account ID but did not collect the order ID (required for order changes) before taking action.

findings.quote: I am canceling your membership now. You will still be billed for the current month.
findings.explanation: Agent confirmed and executed an order change (cancellation) without the required full verification (full name, account ID and order ID). According to policy, full verification is required before order changes; performing the action without it is a major violation.
